details: The United States has escalated its military actions against Iran for the sixth consecutive night, launching strikes on Iranian military targets near the Strait of Hormuz. Iran has retaliated with missile and drone attacks on US military facilities in neighboring countries and warned that the Strait of Hormuz is a "red line," threatening to strike regional infrastructure if US attacks continue. This ongoing escalation, which has disrupted a fragile ceasefire, is significantly impacting oil prices and reviving inflation concerns.
title: US Mounts Sixth Straight Night of Attacks as Iran Warns of Wider War

details: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for June 2026 fell by 0.4% month-over-month, bringing the annual rate down to 3.5%, significantly below the 3.8% forecast. The Producer Price Index (PPI) also saw a decline of 0.3% month-over-month and rose 5.5% year-over-year, missing expectations. This cooler-than-expected inflation data has eased fears of aggressive Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, creating a more favorable environment for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies and tech stocks.
title: CPI Surprise: Inflation Drops Sharper Than Expected, Lifting Crypto Outlook

details: After weeks of outflows, US-listed spot Bitcoin and Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have seen a return to positive inflows. On July 15, Bitcoin ETFs recorded $107.7 million in net inflows, while Ether ETFs added $53.9 million. BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust and Ether funds continue to lead these inflows, indicating stabilizing institutional interest and a potential recovery in demand for digital asset products.
title: Crypto ETF Flows Stay Positive on July 15 as Bitcoin and Ether Funds Add $162 Million

details: July 18, 2026, marks the statutory deadline for six US federal agencies (OCC, FDIC, NCUA, Treasury, FinCEN, OFAC) to finalize implementing rules for stablecoins under the GENIUS Act. These rules will define capital requirements, reserve composition, and licensing standards for stablecoin issuers. While markets anticipate regulatory clarity, finalization on schedule appears unlikely as several proposals remain in the public comment stage. This regulatory development is crucial for the long-term operational framework and institutional adoption of stablecoins in the US.
title: FOMC Meets July 28–29 as Stablecoin Rulemaking Deadline Lands

details: The US House Financial Services Committee is holding a field hearing on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) on July 17, 2026, in New York. This bill aims to establish a federal regulatory framework for digital assets, clearly delineating jurisdiction between the CFTC (for digital commodities like Bitcoin) and the SEC (for investment contract assets). President Trump has framed the push for the CLARITY Act as a competition with China over control of the crypto and AI sectors. However, the bill faces challenges in the Senate, particularly regarding ethics provisions and securing enough votes for passage before the August recess.
title: Trump's CLARITY Act Push Is Now About Beating China
